const box=document.getElementById('crumbs'); const txt=()=>[...box.childNodes].map(n=>n.nodeType===3? n.textContent.trim() : (n.classList&&n.classList.contains('crumb-more')? n.querySelector('.crumb-open').textContent : (n.tagName==='BUTTON'?
